label: Keep disagreeing typed readings in retained values

precheck.description: the fenced publisher exists with its runtime owner
precheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=p.proowner WHERE n.nspname='extraction_runtime' AND p.proname='publish_snapshot' AND p.prosecdef AND r.rolname='free_extraction_runtime') AS ok

postcheck.description: the publisher validates disagreements with a runtime-owned helper
postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='extraction_runtime' AND p.proname='publish_snapshot' AND strpos(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'valid_disagreement(')>0) AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=p.proowner WHERE n.nspname='extraction_runtime' AND p.proname='valid_disagreement' AND r.rolname='free_extraction_runtime') AS ok
